title: Indonesia haze: Singapore deploys ‘quiet diplomacy’ in minister’s surprise visit
text:
Singapore wields ‘quiet diplomacy’ in minister’s surprise visit to Indonesia amid haze tensions | South China Morning Post Politics - Politics Indonesia haze: Singapore deploys ‘quiet diplomacy’ in minister’s surprise visit 1 Advertisement Singapore This Week in Asia Politics Singapore wields ‘quiet diplomacy’ in minister’s surprise visit to Indonesia amid haze tensions 
 Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan’s trip is consistent with Singapore’s measured approach in dealing with its larger neighbour, analysts say
 5 -MIN READ 5 -MIN 1 Listen Kolette Lim in Singapore Published: 10:35pm, 29 Oct 2026 Updated: 12:18am, 30 Oct 2026 Singapore ’s decision to send its top diplomat to Indonesia on a surprise visit, following days of terse exchanges over a regional haze, underscores a bid to defuse growing tensions and seek a direct channel to President Prabowo Subianto . Analysts say Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan’s trip reflected his country’s preference for measured diplomacy amid rising nationalistic rhetoric in Indonesia, with the city state also mindful of containing any “negative fallout” as Jakarta grapples with local protests against the haze. Balakrishnan met Prabowo at his private residence on Wednesday, a day after both states pledged deeper collaboration in tackling transboundary haze .
